The '''Imperial Listening Post''' was a secret installation located on an [[Unidentified Ord Mantell island|island]] off the coast of [[Avilatan]], a far larger island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Built and operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the outpost was used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the intelligence gathered by the monitoring station was used to aid the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]] against the Republic-backed government of Ord Mantell. In [[3643 BBY]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|attacked]] the base in order to access the outpost's communications records and trace the whereabouts of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]. The two were successful in their mission and eliminated dozens of Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed there.

==Description==
{{Quote|I'd go with you to that island, but I'm allergic to blasters.|Ottau|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
The Imperial Listening Post was a largely subterranean facility constructed on an [[Unidentified Ord Mantell island|island]] located off the northern coast of [[Avilatan]], a far larger island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The outpost's entrance was an above-ground bunker that contained a large [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]] to the lower levels, which consisted of one central chamber, two smaller rooms located off that chamber, and a hallway linking the central chamber to a lift. The facility contained advanced surveillance equipment and [[Comm-relay|communications relays]],<ref name="New Intelligence" /> which the outpost's staff used to eavesdrop on the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on Avilatan. The post was located only a short distance from the Republic's primary military base at [[Fort Garnik]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Imperial Listening Post}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Tarnis transmitted details of all our top secret projects to his father. We traced that transmission to the planet Ord Mantell. Darth Angral must have a base there. I need you to find it.|Var Suthra|<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Listening_Post.png|thumb|left|250px|The listening post's lower level]]
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established the listening post sometime during the [[Separatist War]], a civil conflict on Ord Mantell between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-backed planetary government and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. As part of its efforts to destabilize the Republic in the ongoing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Empire backed the separatists, giving them information that the listening post gathered from its observations.<ref name="Codex" /> However, in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] arrived at the outpost with a number of retainers and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]], and he used the facility to contact his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Tarnis was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] who was soon [[Death/Legends|killed]] trying to use the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against Coruscant. Before his death, Tarnis sent his [[Parent/Legends|father]] files on the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], giving Angral knowledge of several Republic weapon programs, and Angral promptly [[Desolator crisis|declared war]] against the Republic for the death of his son.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

The [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, was able to trace the transmission to Ord Mantell and discover the outpost, prompting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to dispatch a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] to Ord Mantell to locate the outpost and potentially put an end to Angral's plans before they could begin. Suthra also contacted on Ord Mantell SIS [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Ottau]], who dispatched a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] to scout the facility&mdash;though the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was quickly destroyed by the Imperials stationed there. Angral and his entourage were departing the facility around the [[Time/Legends|time]] that the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived at Ord Mantell with the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], who accompanied the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] down to Ord Mantell and met with Ottau.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

With Ottau's directions, the duo located the island base and [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|attacked]] it, killing dozens of Imperial personnel, including the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Ord Mantell)|facility commander]]. They had dispatched most of the facility's staff when they reached the listening post's primary [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|hyperspace transceiver]], which was guarded by a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Marcovic]]. Marcovic fell in battle and was unable to prevent T7-O1 from downloading the facility's files and a record of the files that Tarnis sent to Angral. Their mission complete, the Knight and T7-O1 departed the Imperial base and met with Ottau, who planned to send an SIS team to secure the facility.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Listening Post is a location created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. It serves as a class-restricted phase for the Jedi Knight class on the planet Ord Mantell, accessible only during the mission "New Intelligence."<ref name="New Intelligence" /> The location also received an entry in the in-game Codex<ref name="Codex" /> and was pictured&mdash;though not labeled&mdash;in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
